name: Overdrive
author: Musika
description: ROG Ally controls on Windows: performance modes with their own watts, Auto TDP, FPS limit, CPU and GPU fan curves, CPU Boost, Windows power mode, controller mode, grip vibration, touchscreen and Auto SR. Unofficial; based on G-Helper. Needs Decky Loader for Windows.

name: Control Center
author: Musika
description: Brightness, volume, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and the ASUS battery charge limit from the Quick Access menu on Windows. Needs Decky Loader for Windows.

name: Clarity
author: Musika
description: Per-game OptiScaler on Windows: install it into a game, pick the AMD FSR 4 model (Lite, Standard or Auto) and turn frame generation on or off, then remove it cleanly. Uses the FSR 4 files from your AMD driver. Warns about anti-cheat games; don't use it in online games. Packs a pre-release OptiScaler build. Unofficial. Needs Decky Loader for Windows.
